tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dh+wa dza a gra ke yūr nā ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ces bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i nang na lwa ba dkar po lta bu'i rdo leb la bzhugs te/ de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin lha ma yin rnams las pham/ rab tu pham nas de rtab cing rings pa'i gzugs kyis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das bdag 'di ltar lha ma yin dang g.yul bkye ba las/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs ris las pham/ rab tu pham ste/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyang pham/ rab tu pham na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis de la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po khyod kyis rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ces bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gzungs zungs shig ngas kyang sngon byang chub sems dpar gyur pa na de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan las 'di mnos so// mnos nas kyang gzhan la rgya cher yang dag par bshad do// mngon par dran te de tshun chad 'jigs pa'am/ bag tsha ba'am/ spu zing zhes byed pa'am/ tha na skad cig yud tsam yang lus la gnod pa byung ma myong ngo*// bcom ldan 'das rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan zhes bgyi pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gzungs de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ dza ya bā hi na/ shang ka ri shang ka ri/

pra bhaṃ ka ri/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ sarba sha trūṃ/ dzaṃ bha ya dzaṃ bha ya/ stam+bha ya stam+bha ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ bha ga ba ti/ dza ya bā hi ni/ ma tha ma tha/ pra ma tha pra ma tha/ gra sa gra sa/ ha sa ha sa/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ la hūm̐ la hūm̐/ lam+bo da ri/ tre ne tre/ tsa tur bāk+t+re/ tsa tur daṃṣ+ṭā+e/ tsa tur bhu dze/ a si mu sa la/ tsakra/ tri shū la/ badz+ra ka ba tsa dhā ra ṇi/ bdag gnod pa thams cad las srungs shig srungs shig oṃ bha ga ba ti/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ma tha ma tha/ pra ma tha pra ma tha/ dhu na dhu na/ bi dhu na bi dhū na/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ bhañdza bhañdza/ pa ra sai n+ya/ bi dh+wan+sa ya/ sarba sha trūṃ nā sha ya/ dh+wa dza a gra ke yū re/ tri ṭa tri ṭa tri ṭa/ bh+ri ṭa bh+ri ṭa/ ulkā mu khi ulkā dhā ra ṇī/ trai lo kya ma thā ni/ bidhān+sa ya pa ra sai n+yan/ bdag gnod pa thams cad las srungs shig srungs shig tsa la tsa la/ tsi li tsi li/ tsu lu tsu lu/ kaṃ pa kaṃ pa/ ka la ka la/ ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ muñdza muñdza/ aṭ+ṭa hā saṃ bi dhān+sa ya/ pa ra sain+yan/ bdag gnod pa thams cad las srungs shig srungs shig trā sa ya trā sa ya/ bh+rā ma ya bh+rā ma ya/ bud+dha sa t+yen/ dharma sa t+yen/ saṃgha sa t+yen/ sat+ya pā dī nāṃ/ sat+yen/ bud+dha sa t+ye mā ti kra ma/ dharma sat+ye mā ti kra ma/ saṃ gha sa t+ye mā ti kra ma/ sat+ye bā di nāṃ/ sat+ye mā ti kra ma/ lam+bo da ri/ lam+bo da ri/ ku ṭa ku ṭa/ kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa/ kuṭ+ṭā pa ya kuṭ+ṭā pa ya/ ru dra ma nā ya/ biṣ+ṇu ma nā ya/ tsan+d+ra sūr+ya brah+mam nā ya trai lo kya a dhi pa ti ma nā ya sarba de ba a dhi pa ti ma nā ya/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ gan dhar+bha/ kuṃ bhaṇ+ḍa/ ma ho ra ga adhi pa ti ma nā ya/ bi dh+wan+sa ya pa ra sain+ya/ raṃ ga raṃ ga raṃ gā pa ya ra gā pa ya/ dz+wā la dz+wā la/ puṣ+pa mā li ni/ run+dha run+dha/ ri ti ri ti/ tsi ti tsi ti/ dh+ri ti dh+ri ti/ bhṛ ku ṭi/ mu kha pa ra se na ku lota sā da ni ka ri/

ha la ha la/ hi li hi li/ hu lu hu lu/ he he/ ri ni ri ni/ ri ni ma ti/ dzaṃ bha dh+wa dze/ sarba bud+dha/ a ba lo ki te/ bdag 'jigs pa thams cad las srungs shig srungs shig sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te swā hā/ gu ṇa rā dza pra bhā sot+ta me swā hā/ sūr+ya arka bi ma le swā hā/ tsan+d+ra arka bi ma le swā hā/ sarba gra ha nak+ṣa tra dhe mī ka ra ṇa swā hā/ bdag 'jigs pa dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/ 'khrug pa thams cad las srungs shig srungs shig swā hā/ lha'i rgyal po rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ces bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gzungs 'dis khyod g.yul sprod pa'am/ 'thab pa'am/ rtsod pa'am/ 'gyed pa'am/ gang du 'gro yang rung ste mi 'jigs shing thams cad du rgyal bar 'gyur ro// rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'am/ mgul du btags na mi'i rgyal po dang*/ skyes bu dpa' bo thams cad la srung bar byed do// bud med kyi gzugs lta bur bsgyur nas mdun du 'dug ste mi 'jigs pa sbyin zhing srung bar byed/ dpal skyed par byed/ pha rol gyi sde spa bkong bar byed/ bkra shis pa dang*/ gtsang pa dang*/ grags pa dang*/ dpal dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa kun tu gnas par byed do// bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang*/ lha dang*/ mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ces bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus de skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ dh+wa dza a gra ke yū ra sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan nag mo zhal gsum phyag bzhi ma/

g.yas kyi zhal dmar ba/ ral gri dang zhags pa ni g.yas kyi phyag gnyis na'o// rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang 'khor lo ni g.yon gyi phyag gnyis na'o// skra kham pa gyen du 'greng ma/ thod pa skam po lnga'i phreng bas mgo la brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhal mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ lto ba 'phyang ba/ nyi ma'i 'od dang zla ba'i gdan la g.yon brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis gnas pa/ na bza' ser po'i sha 'gag can/ sa bon ni hūm̐ ste mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ 'gro ba'i don du bsgom par bya'o// oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ bzlas pa'i sngags so// rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs la/ sgrub pa pos sems bskyed la tshogs gnyis bsag go /stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gam/ yang na sa bon gyi spro bsdu las bskyed do// mi bskyod pa rang chas su'o// spro na snying gar pad nyi la oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ bkod la bzla'o// dha bai'i bzhed pa'o// / rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan la'ang gnyis te/ lha bskyed pa dang*/ bzlas pa bya ba'o// zhes pa ni bla ma sa chen gyi gsung gi dum bu'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ 'phags ma rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis 'di'i rjes gnang dang lung bla ma las blangs te gnas dben par bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis 'khod/ nges 'byung dang byang chub kyi sems yid la byas te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs kyis skyabs 'gro dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags ma rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o// zhes sems bskyed/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā ba'i sngags brjod de/ rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid lha mo rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan sku mdog nag mo zhal gsum phyag bzhi ma/ rtsa zhal mthing nag g.yas zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal ljang gu/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang*/ na bza' ser po'i sha 'gag can/ lto ba 'phyang ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ 'od zer dang ldan pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad lha mo rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ thugs kar sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam zhing*/

oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi skal ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim par bsam mo// rjes gnang byed na/ gnas dben par maṇ+ḍa lar dri bzang gi thig le byas te 'bras kyi tshom bu gcig dgod/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du ting ting shags dang*/ me tog la sogs pa bshams la/ mchod pa rnams a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā/ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bhā we/ badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swā hā/ zhes dang so so'i phyag rgya bya zhing mthar rol mo dkrol te byin dbab/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gong bdag bskyed kyi rigs 'gres sbyar la bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ oṃ bha ga wa tī dh+wa dza a gra ke yūr sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid// sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/

gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ a kā ro lan gsum gyis dbul/ mchod bstod byas la 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ 'das gtor gyi lhag ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas mgron bkug la/ sngags de nyid kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ 'jig rten pa yi 'byung po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// chos don bden pa la gnas nas// zhi zhing dul ba'i sems su mdzod// bdag kyang byang chub ma thob bar// gegs med bar chad med pa dang*// dam tshig gnas la gnas mdzod la// byang chub thob pa'i grogs kyang mdzod// ces pas phrin las gzhol/ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha zhes pas 'jig rten pa'i gtor mgron gshegs su gsol/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng bsams la/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pas thugs rgyud bskur bar bsam zhing gong ltar bzlas pa ci rigs bya/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag byas la/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i byams pa dang*/ 'khor ba las sgrol 'dod kyi snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la 'jug sgo mang du yod pa las 'dir rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas lha'i rnal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa rnams 'phags yul gyi slob dpon so sos thugs nyams su bzhes shing*/

sgrub pa'i thabs rgyas bsdus sna tshogs mdzad pa rnams slob dpon chen po rdo rje gdan pa dang*/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta a bha yā ka ra sogs kyis phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa spyi dang*/ bye brag gi bka' srol kyang mtha' yas par bzhugs pa las/ sgrub pa'i thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho gnyis ka nas bstan cing*/ pha rol gyi g.yul las rgyal ba sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag srung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ phyir zlog pa la mchog tu bsngags pa 'phags ma rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan zhes bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ rgyud yongs su dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas slob dpon la lhag pa'i lha mo dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'phags ma rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos pa byas te/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog ces rgyud dag par byas nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la bcom ldan 'das ma rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba 'debs pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la/ thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas haṃ/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang gi phung po khams dang nas/ gyur pa las khyed rang rnams re re nas lha mo rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i sogs nas/ 'od zer dang ldan pa zhes pa'i bar gyis bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la/ rnam pa 'phags ma rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sku tshad med grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang rol mo bya zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes yang yang brjod pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ lus bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod par mos pa byas te me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces dang*/ sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug de ltar lan gsum bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te slob dpon la me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/

de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rgyud la bcom ldan 'das ma rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog 'thor/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 'phags ma rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan yi dam du gzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du 'phags ma rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ de ltar byas pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ ngag bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsung dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ byin gyis rlob pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa re thugs ka nas rgyangs kyis bye nas byon pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim ste thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig dang dbyer med du gyur par mos pa gyis/ de'i ngang nas lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid cher gyis gtad pas/ rang nyid lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/

sa bon de'ang je chung je phrar gyur te mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa la brten nas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu rgyud la skyes par mos pa byas te cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ de ltar byas pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ sems bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes dam tshig bsdus te 'dzin par khas blangs nas rjes su gnang ba rnams rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod thams cad slob dpon la 'bul/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// de rnams kyis rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod cing slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtong ngo*// rjes chog ni/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas mchod cing bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po zhes gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag

/rgyal mtshan rtse mo 'grub sogs bsngo smon dang*/ ston mchog dam pa sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ji ltar rigs pa brjod par bya'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan kyi rig pa rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor bzhugs su gsol ba'am/ mchod rten lta bu'i tog gi nang du bzhugs su gsol ba'i cho ga ni/ gzungs dag par bris te gur gum dang*/ byin rten sogs kyis byugs/ rab tu gnas/ 'bru sman rin po che'i rigs dang bcas lhan cig tu gzhug ste/ de'i mdun du mchod gtor bsham/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ma las 'byung ba'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas gong ltar bya ba'am/ cho ga gzhan dang 'brel na bdag bskyed zur du ma grub kyang rung*/ cha gsum gtor ma'am gzhi bdag la dkar gtor gtang*/ mdun rten la sbyong khrus sngon du 'gro bas bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las lha mo rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan sku mdog nag mo zhal gsum phyag bzhi ma/ rtsa zhal mthing nag g.yas zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal ljang gu/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing*/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan zhing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang*/ na bza' ser po'i sha 'gag can/ lto ba 'phyang ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ 'od zer dang ldan pa/ de'ang steng gi cha la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ mtha' skor kun tu chos skyong 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ bdag dang rten gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags ma rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs chos skyong ba dang 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ mchod phreng rgyas pa'am/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bha ga wa ti dh+wa dzā gra ke yū ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ spyi bstod rgyas pa'am bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis brlab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bha ga wa ti dhā dzā gra ke yū ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs gsum gyis phul/ mchod cing bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di zhes la// sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ thugs rgyud bskul bar dmigs te gzungs tshar grangs ci nus klog pa dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes snying po'ang brgya rtsa sogs bzlas mthar/ ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa dang*/ 'dod don gsol gdab ji ltar rigs pa bya/ me tog bcas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs chos skyong 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gis 'phags ma rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi gzungs sngags rin po ches yi ger bris te rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad la pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi 'jigs pa sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag srung ba dang*/

zhi ba dang*/ phyir zlog pa dang*/ phan bde bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i dngos grub stsol bar ci gnang*/ sngon lha'i dbang po la dpal gyi mgur nas 'di skad du/ lha'i rgyal po rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ces bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gzungs 'dis khyod g.yul sprod pa'am/ 'thab pa'am/ rtsod pa'am/ 'gyed pa'am/ gang du 'gro yang rung ste/ mi 'jigs shing thams cad du rgyal bar 'gyur ro// rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'am/ mgul du btags na mi'i rgyal po dang*/ skyes bu dpa' bo thams cad la srung bar byed do// bud med kyi gzugs lta bur bsgyur nas mdun du 'dug ste/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin zhing srung bar byed do// dpal skyed par byed/ pha rol gyi sde spa bkong bar byed do// bkra shis pa dang*/ gtsang ba dang*/ grags pa dang*/ dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa kun tu gnas par byed do// zhes bka' stsal pa'i phan yon thams cad bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad la 'phral du 'grub par ci gnang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa tshad mar gyur pas ji ltar bka' stsal pa bzhin bden pa mngon sum du bstan par ci gnang*/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab cing me tog 'thor/ de de bzhin tu zhal gyis bzhes par bsam/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod bya/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyi mthar/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis nongs pa bshags/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu// sogs kyi mthar/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang*/ ye dharmāḥbarjod cing me tog gi char babs/ nam mkha' gang ba'i tshogs zhing rnams rten dang dbyer med du thim pas byin gyis brlabs shing*/ slar yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mkha' khyab tu sad pas bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa du mas kyang mnga' gsol bar gyur/ che ba'i che mchog sogs bkra shis ji ltar rigs pa brjod do// zhes pa'ang rje de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs chog la zhal bkod ltar 'di'i gzhung sgrub rjes nyer mkho'i yig cha rnams blo gter dbang pos phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel//
